safeMessage.title: Safe Message
safeMessage.description: Safe status message for the Account Manager account directory request.

accountDirectory.title: Account Manager Account Directory
accountDirectory.description: Formatted list of Account Manager Accounts with copyable Salesforce Account IDs and safe commercial attention signals.

accountCount.title: Account Count
accountCount.description: Number of Accounts returned in this response.

resultLimit.title: Result Limit
resultLimit.description: Maximum number of Accounts requested after safety caps.

hasMore.title: Has More Accounts

accountIds.title: Account Ids
accountIds.description: Semicolon-separated Salesforce Account IDs returned in this response.

topAccountId.title: Top Account Id
topAccountId.description: Planner-only Salesforce Account ID for the top-ranked account so the agent can hand off into the account-health summary after confirmation without requiring manual copy/paste.

topAccountName.title: Top Account Name
topAccountName.description: Planner-only Account name for the top-ranked account in the directory response.

topAccountAttentionSignals.title: Top Account Attention Signals
topAccountAttentionSignals.description: Planner-only safe attention-signal summary for the top-ranked account in the directory response.

attentionBasis.title: Attention Basis
attentionBasis.description: Planner-only explanation that the directory uses Salesforce-visible signals for selection, not LLM-led portfolio scoring.
